facts.text: I have JavaScript/jQuery code that submits a form with fields dvdTitle, maxPrice, and category.
My code sends a GET request to http://localhost:8081/filmtitle when maxPrice is empty and category is null.
My code sends a GET request to http://localhost:8081/categoryname when maxPrice is not empty or category is not null.
My code stores the AJAX response data in sessionStorage under the key searchResults.
My code navigates to searchResults.html after storing searchResults in sessionStorage.
I have code that reads searchResults from sessionStorage and loops through it to build HTML cards.
My code creates a "View Film Details" button as a link to viewUsers.html with userid from user.userid.
I want the "View Film Details" button to go to filmDetails.html and pass searchResults into that page.
I modified the "View Film Details" button to link to filmDetails.html with a query parameter searchResults containing JSON.stringify(searchResults).
I want to save the data stored in var user into sessionStorage when the "View Film Details" button is pressed and then send the data into filmDetails.html.
I asked where to insert code that sets sessionStorage.setItem("selectedFilm", JSON.stringify(user)) on click of elements with class .View.
I have code that sets up a click handler for elements with class .View inside a loop over searchResults.
When I click "View Film Details" on another card, I only get the same index.
